function.arguments: {"index": 5, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The cross-tabulation revealed a systematic imbalance in customer segment between channels: email was targeted at loyal and returning customers, while paid_search attracted more new customers. This creates a confounding variable. A raw difference in conversion rates between channels would reflect both the campaign effect and the underlying segment differences. To isolate the campaign effect, I computed the difference in conversion rates within each customer segment (email minus paid_search), then computed a weighted average of these segment-level differences, using segment size as weight. This stratified approach adjusts for the imbalance and provides a valid estimate of the campaign's effect on conversion."}
function.name: resolve_finding
